name: homemove
description: Get Homemove quotes for moving home in ChatGPT: surveys, valuations, EPCs and safety certificates, conveyancing, removals and moving cleans, priced from the address, plus a whole move set out step by step with stamp duty.

interface.shortDescription: Quotes for every part of moving home
interface.longDescription:
Homemove prices the services you need when you move home, right in the conversation, and shows each quote with the Homies.

Ask what a survey, a valuation, an EPC, a gas safety or electrical certificate, conveyancing, removals or a moving clean would cost and Homemove works it out from Homemove's own pricing. Give the address and it fills in what it can from the property records, such as bedrooms and freehold or leasehold, so you answer fewer questions; anything it still needs, it asks. For removals, tell it what you are moving or pick room by room, and it works out the van, the crew and the guide price for the distance.

Planning a whole move? Say whether you are buying, selling, both, renting or letting, and Homemove sets out every step with its Homemove quote: the EPC, the conveyancing for each side, the survey, removals and the clean, plus the stamp duty you would pay to HMRC, shown apart from Homemove's fees. Not sure which survey you need? Homemove explains the difference and quotes the one that fits.

When you are ready, each quote opens the matching booking page on homemove.com, with the service and postcode filled in.

Limitations: Quotes are confirmed when you book on homemove.com. Some combinations, such as very large homes or expert-witness valuations, are quoted by the Homemove team rather than instantly. Homemove does not give mortgage advice, recommend lenders or quote insurance in ChatGPT. Stamp duty figures cover England and Northern Ireland and are estimates, not tax advice. Homemove needs no account and takes no payments in ChatGPT.
capabilities: Survey and valuation quotes from the address
EPC, gas safety and electrical certificate quotes
Conveyancing quotes for buying or selling
Removals guide prices from what you are moving
End of tenancy and moving clean quotes
Your whole move set out step by step
Stamp duty at current HMRC rates
Book on homemove.com with the details filled in
